description: Na₃AlTe₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one Al and six Te atoms. The Na-Al bond length is 3.30 Å. There are a spread of Na-Te bond distances ranging from 3.16-3.69 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Al and six Te atoms. There is one shorter (3.45 Å) and one longer (3.48 Å) Na-Al bond length. There are a spread of Na-Te bond distances ranging from 3.10-3.68 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four Te atoms. There are a spread of Na-Te bond distances ranging from 3.19-3.30 Å. Al is bonded to three Na and four Te atoms to form distorted face-sharing AlNa₃Te₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Al-Te bond distances ranging from 2.58-2.68 Å. There are three inequivalent Te sites. In the first Te site, Te is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to four Na and two equivalent Al atoms. In the second Te site, Te is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Al atom. In the third Te site, Te is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Al atom.
